name: Sani Yang Yeongusil
source:
You open your eyes to find yourself within the mysterious world of the Therio, home to a wide array of anthropomorphic creatures.

As you gather your senses, you realize that Professor Sani, a genius scientist, and Namo, her devoted assistant, have saved you from the brink of death. Yet, to pay for the mountain of medical expenses that have piled up during that time, you have no choice but to become a "test subject" for the lab, digging into the secrets of the experiments being conducted in search of a way out of their clutches.

As you interact with the lab researchers, each with their own quirky personality traits, and deepen your bonds with the Therio kind, you will eventually find yourself facing a crossroads and the questions that lie beneath: What truth is this laboratory concealing, and what part does it play in your ultimate fate?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464370/Sani_Yangs_Laboratory/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你睁开眼睛，发现自己身处Therio的神秘世界，这里是各种拟人生物的家园。

当你回过神来时，你意识到天才科学家萨尼教授和她忠实的助手纳莫将你从死亡边缘拯救了出来。然而，为了支付那段时间堆积如山的医疗费用，你别无选择，只能成为实验室的“实验对象”，挖掘实验的秘密，寻找摆脱他们魔爪的出路。

当你与实验室的研究人员（每个人都有自己古怪的性格特征）互动时，并加深你与Therio类型的联系时，你最终会发现自己面临一个十字路口和隐藏在下面的问题：这个实验室隐藏着什么真相，它在你的最终命运中扮演什么角色？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464370/Sani_Yangs_Laboratory/]Steam[/url]]
